sourceItems.title: Shortage of personal protective equipment endangering health workers worldwide
normalizedClaims: WHO warned of severe global PPE shortages, said surgical-mask prices had risen about sixfold and N95 respirators about threefold, and estimated manufacturing needed to increase by 40% to meet demand.

sourceItems.title: 沪产口罩“心脏”材料产量增33% 日均口罩芯产量达800万片
normalizedClaims: Meltblown-mask raw-material production was being expanded rapidly; a new line increased daily special-material output by 33%, highlighting meltblown material as the mask-production bottleneck.
observedChanges: mask-material bottleneck triggers emergency capacity expansion

sourceItems.title: 工业和信息化部关于推动5G加快发展的通知
normalizedClaims: MIIT formally called for accelerating 5G network construction, application deployment, technology development and security, emphasizing the scale effect of new infrastructure.

sourceItems.title: Owing to Partial Work Resumption and Pre-Chinese New Year Stocking of Components, Chinese Server Shipment to Remain Healthy for Now
normalizedClaims: Chinese server supply-chain recovery was better than expected; 5G infrastructure server orders had not been materially cut, telecom-operator server demand was projected to grow 120% YoY to 300k units, and telework/distance education were lifting cloud-server demand.
observedChanges: server demand remains resilient despite epidemic

sourceItems.title: Despite Rising 2Q20 Server DRAM and Enterprise SSD Prices, Expanding COVID-19 Outbreak Means 2H20 Supply and Demand Situation Remains Important Point of Consideration
normalizedClaims: TrendForce raised its 2Q20 server-DRAM price forecast to about +20% QoQ and enterprise-SSD forecast to +10-15%, citing telework/cloud demand and low inventories, while flagging uncertainty for 2H20.
observedChanges: server-memory pricing outlook accelerates for Q2

sourceItems.title: TrendForce Presents Latest Analysis (Updated March 2020) of COVID-19 Pandemic’s Impact on Global High-Tech Industries
normalizedClaims: Late-March work-from-home and education notebook demand had surfaced, but Q1 notebook supply was badly disrupted and TrendForce still lowered the 2020 notebook shipment forecast due global demand uncertainty.
observedChanges: remote-work demand emerges but consumer hardware outlook remains conflicted

sourceItems.title: China's Feb auto sales plunge 79%, biggest monthly drop ever
normalizedClaims: China auto sales fell about 79% YoY in February to 310k vehicles; NEV sales were also contracting, while CAAM expected a rebound only as epidemic restrictions eased.

sourceItems.title: Oil suffers rout after Saudi Arabia fires first shot of price war
normalizedClaims: Oil fell more than 25% after Saudi Arabia cut selling prices and planned higher output following Russia's refusal of deeper OPEC cuts, compounding a coronavirus-driven demand shock.
observedChanges: oil supply war collides with demand destruction
energy earnings regime turns sharply negative

sourceItems.title: Gold set for biggest weekly drop in nearly 7 years in virus-led sell-off
normalizedClaims: Gold was down about 6.7% for the week as investors sold even safe-haven assets to meet margin calls during the equity crash.
observedChanges: safe-haven gold temporarily becomes a liquidity source

sourceItems.title: Gold rises over 1% as U.S. Fed ramps up support measures
normalizedClaims: Gold rebounded sharply after the Federal Reserve announced unprecedented support measures, showing a transition from forced liquidation back toward monetary-stimulus support.
observedChanges: gold liquidity stress reverses after extraordinary monetary support

sourceItems.title: 2020年1—2月份全国规模以上工业企业利润下降38.3%
normalizedClaims: Jan-Feb industrial profits fell 38.3%; electronics manufacturing profits fell 87.0%, autos 79.6%, electrical machinery 68.2%, while only a small minority of industries grew.
observedChanges: many apparent structural themes lack near-term earnings confirmation

sourceItems.title: 2020年3月中国采购经理指数运行情况
normalizedClaims: March manufacturing PMI rebounded to 52.0 from February's collapse as work resumed, but NBS explicitly cautioned that the rebound did not mean economic activity had returned to normal.
observedChanges: production resumes rapidly from an extreme low base

eventClusters.statement: COVID-19 created an acute global PPE shortage with extreme mask/respirator price increases and emergency expansion of meltblown-material capacity, creating a real but potentially short-lived scarcity profit pool.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Capacity was being expanded aggressively, so deep research must distinguish durable earnings conversion from a temporary shortage already reflected in prices.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share expressions, if any, had direct verified capacity and realizable profit before the shortage normalized, without relying on concept-stock exposure?

eventClusters.statement: China explicitly accelerated 5G infrastructure policy while industry evidence showed 5G server orders remained intact and telecom-operator server demand was expected to rise sharply.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Policy direction is strong but 5G was already a widely followed theme; deep research must test company-specific earnings conversion and expectation absorption.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did any direct network-infrastructure supplier have a measurable 2020 earnings bridge that was not already fully capitalized?

eventClusters.statement: Telework, distance education and cloud demand tightened server-memory supply enough for TrendForce to raise 2Q server-DRAM price expectations to about +20% QoQ, despite uncertainty beyond Q2.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Consumer electronics and notebook supply/demand were simultaneously weak/conflicted, so deep research must isolate server/cloud exposure rather than promote generic semiconductor names.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there a direct A-share server/cloud or memory expression with verified earnings conversion and room beyond an already-visible Q2 price upcycle?

eventClusters.statement: Coronavirus demand destruction collided with a Saudi-Russia supply war, causing an historic oil-price collapse and abruptly reversing the earnings regime for upstream energy.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Low oil is not automatically bullish for downstream companies because global demand was collapsing at the same time; avoid simplistic input-cost beneficiary mapping.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Should upstream oil exposure be avoided, and are there any downstream beneficiaries whose demand survives strongly enough for the input-cost windfall to matter?

eventClusters.statement: China February auto sales fell roughly 79% YoY, the worst monthly decline on record, while NEV demand also contracted, leaving the industry in an earnings trough rather than a confirmed recovery.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: A future rebound is plausible but not yet observed at the cutoff. Deep research should fail closed unless a company-specific engine is independently realized.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is this an avoid/wait signal rather than a contrarian long at 2020Q1 cutoff?

eventClusters.statement: Gold first sold off sharply as investors raised cash during the market crisis, then rebounded after extraordinary Federal Reserve support, leaving a potentially improving monetary regime but unusually unstable price discovery.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The fundamental monetary thesis strengthened, but crisis liquidity caused violent two-way moves. Deep research must test whether miner earnings and equity expectations offer a cleaner expression than the commodity headline.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did the post-liquidation monetary reset create an under-reflected miner opportunity, or was the signal still too unstable?

eventClusters.statement: China's March PMI rebounded sharply as factories restarted from February's extreme shutdown, while Jan-Feb industrial profits remained deeply negative and NBS cautioned that activity was not yet normal.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: This is a low-base reopening signal, not proof of normalized earnings. Use to test early-inflection logic and as context, not as a generic long.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Are there narrow industries with direct order/earnings evidence that can convert the reopening before broad profits recover?

eventClusters.statement: Work-from-home and education demand emerged late in March, but notebook supply had been badly disrupted and the full-year notebook forecast was still cut, producing a conflicted hardware signal.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Do not infer a broad hardware long from WFH headlines while supply and global consumer demand remain impaired.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there any component bottleneck with direct pricing power, or should this remain unresolved at cutoff?

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff PPE price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: PPE basket 20d excess +4.21pp and 60d +137.52pp with 100% positive breadth. 道恩股份 alone had +265.02pp 60d excess, indicating extreme expectation absorption.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff 5G price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: 5G basket 20d excess +3.12pp and 60d +25.76pp; breadth 66.7%/100%; favorable, but 中兴通讯 had -8.79pp 20d excess after strong 60d rerating.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff server price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Server basket 20d excess -3.25pp and 60d +36.56pp; breadth 0%/100%; neutral. Both 浪潮信息 and 中科曙光 had materially rerated over 60d but corrected in the final 20d.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff memory-theme price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Memory-theme basket 20d excess -19.71pp and 60d +18.83pp; breadth 0%/100%; neutral after a sharp late-Q1 de-rating.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff gold-equity price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Gold-equity basket 20d excess +3.75pp and 60d +4.26pp with only 50% breadth; favorable by rule but cross-sectional confirmation is weak.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff auto price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Auto basket was benchmark-relative favorable during the market crash despite record physical demand collapse. This is a deliberate test against treating relative-price resilience as sufficient without a positive earnings bridge.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff oil-equity price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Oil-equity basket had +4.56pp 20d excess but -2.17pp 60d excess; neutral while the commodity earnings regime was sharply negative.

evidenceDocuments.title: 道恩股份防疫物资生产一线保供
normalizedClaims: By mid-February 道恩 had shipped more than 2,000 tonnes of mask-grade polypropylene meltblown material and was running around the clock, confirming direct physical exposure to PPE demand.

evidenceDocuments.title: 口罩概念股大涨，多家公司澄清口罩生产事项
normalizedClaims: 道恩股份 disclosed that polypropylene meltblown-material sales were not a high share of total revenue; multiple mask-theme companies warned that actual mask/PPE contribution was small or not commercialized.

evidenceDocuments.title: 熔喷料销售占比仅13% 口罩龙头道恩股份炒作成妖？
normalizedClaims: By March 6 道恩股份 had risen about 325% since Feb 3 and traded around 129x PE; 2018 meltblown special-material revenue was about 13.4% of consolidated revenue, and the company warned orders could fall as the epidemic came under control.

evidenceDocuments.title: 中兴通讯2019年年度报告
normalizedClaims: 2019 revenue RMB90.74bn +6.1%; operator-network revenue RMB66.58bn +16.7%; attributable profit RMB5.15bn; operating cash flow RMB7.45bn +180.8%; R&D spend RMB12.55bn or 13.8% of revenue.

evidenceDocuments.title: 中兴通讯2019年年报点评：国内格局稳固，海外业务快速恢复
normalizedClaims: Forecast 2020/21/22 net profit RMB5.98/8.01/10.83bn and EPS 1.30/1.74/2.35; research used 40x 2020 PE for a RMB52 target and emphasized operator-network and 5G growth.

evidenceDocuments.title: 浪潮信息：19Q4服务器出货大幅回升，浪潮逆势增长尽显龙头之风
normalizedClaims: Global Q4 2019 server shipments +14% YoY and sales +7.5%; remote work plus 5G were expected to accelerate server demand. Forecast 浪潮 2020E revenue RMB70.39bn +27.8%, net profit RMB1.268bn +41.7%, EPS 0.98 and PE 44.6x at the report price.

evidenceDocuments.title: 中科曙光2019年年度报告
normalizedClaims: 2019 revenue RMB9.526bn +5.18%, attributable profit RMB593.6m +37.86%,扣非 RMB384.9m +41.71%, and operating cash flow RMB3.174bn +402.93%.

evidenceDocuments.title: 中科曙光：毛利率大幅提升，国产化快速推进
normalizedClaims: 2019 profit +37.86%,扣非 +41.71%, cash flow +402.93%; higher-margin software and domestic-CPU servers gained mix, and domestic CPU-server products were entering volume production. Forecast 2020/21 EPS 1.26/1.44 with RMB55 six-month target.

evidenceDocuments.title: 山东黄金：资源禀赋优异，增储优势突出
normalizedClaims: The report expected monetary easing to support gold, but forecast 山东黄金 2020E EPS 0.42 versus 2019E 0.50; at March 16 price the implied 2020E PE was about 75x and 2021E PE about 60x, indicating a heavy expectation burden.

evidenceDocuments.title: 半导体核心产品涨价：国产替代预期强烈 资金扎堆买
normalizedClaims: The memory upcycle and domestic-substitution narrative was already widely traded; 兆易创新 and 北京君正 were among memory-theme names, and many had already pulled back 20-30% from highs by mid-March.
